sources.coverage_semantics: all liquidation events published by the exchange
latest liquidation order per symbol within each 1000 ms window

cross_source_policy.reason: An exchange liquidation is a venue-specific event. Cascades can occur at similar times on multiple venues, but they are not duplicate source records.

promotion_boundary: Adding a source authorizes data collection only. It does not authorize replay, strategy promotion, order execution, DCA, leverage, or live capital.
